svg.title: A segment is one column set
svg.desc: A column set stores column count and byte lengths, followed by separate time, ID, parent, duration, and five argument streams. The streams shown are the nine RECORD_BLOCK columns.
svg.text: A segment is one column set
RECORD_BLOCK example · streams are concatenated in column order
